method: Static reading only (GNU objdump, guarded Python byte reads); CLEA_VEO.exe was not executed or emulated. Research: analysis/front-phcallback/RECOVERY.md.
loop: [D] Duration handler 0x501e20 copies the chosen Extended seconds from the table 0x5b3a40 (10 bytes per entry) to TPhotometer+0x57b; repeat handler 0x501e60 stores slider+1 at +0x585.
[D] Start 0x500a01..0x500a0d: fild Timer (env+0x2e57), fdiv Single 1000.0 (0x500ac8), fstp TBYTE +0x498: the increment is Timer/1000 rounded once to the precision-control mantissa.
[D] 0x500bcc (Start) and 0x501911 (each later period) zero the elapsed Extended +0x48e (dwords +0x48e/+0x492, word +0x496).
[D] Callback 0x5014ea..0x5014f8: fld +0x48e, fld +0x498, faddp, fstp TBYTE +0x48e: elapsed is rounded to the mantissa at every add and stored exactly (80-bit).

[D] The same callback then draws source and sky (0x501506..0x501561), adds BaseCount to the Integer base-count sum +0x4de (0x501588) and only then compares: 0x5015cb..0x5015dd fld +0x48e, fld +0x57b, fcompp, ja 0x50196c continues while seconds > elapsed. So the period ends at the first callback with elapsed >= seconds, and that callback's photons and base count are counted.
[D] Reduction 0x501687..0x5016ba divides the aggregate count +0x4fa and the base-count sum +0x4de by repeats x table seconds (+0x585 x +0x57b), never by the callback count.

[D] Display 0x500d80 (called at 0x500a2a and 0x501982) shows the period's elapsed Extended through 0x486268 (ffFixed, 1 digit, padded to 5 characters) and the completed-period index; after a non-final period 0x501911 has already zeroed elapsed.

[I] No DLL or the OS leaves another precision or rounding control in force at run time.

domain.note: [W] WEB-T6-02: the web measures Timer Wait 1..10000 ms.

rule: Over the whole domain the count equals ceil(1000 * seconds / Timer) except at the 18 pairs below, all exact multiples (ties), where it is one more. No non-tie pair differs.

compiled.note: At the compiled 100 ms only 100 s changes. The increment 14757395258967641293/2^67 is above 0.1 and the sums after 10 and 100 adds are still at or above 1 and 10, but the rounding of the larger partial sums leaves the sum of 1000 adds 125/2^57 (8.7e-16) below 100, so the 1001st callback ends the period at elapsed 100.0999999999999991 (VIREO displays 100.1).

tools.method: Exact Python Fraction model of fdiv/faddp with 64-bit-mantissa round-to-nearest-even; reads the table, the Single and the control word from the executable.
gcc long double on x86-64 Linux (hardware x87, control word set to 0x1332); a numeric model, not VIREO.

witnesses.agreement: Both tools produce the same 40000-row table byte for byte; the production BigInt model (src/core/photometerCallbackCount.ts) reproduces it in photometerCallbackCount.test.ts.

sensitivity: [I] With precision control 53 bits (0x1232) 26 of the 40000 pairs would differ, among them 1 s at 100 ms (11 callbacks) and 10 s at 100 ms (101): the count depends on the control word, hence the [I] above.

browserPolicy.rule: [W] A live Start whose count or full-domain count guard differs between the nominal and the exact rule first records one callbackCount event; from it on every Start of the session uses the exact count. Histories without it (owners 4-17) keep the nominal count, ceil(1000 * seconds / Timer), and replay byte-identically. Elsewhere the two rules agree, so no event is recorded and the owner is unchanged.
browserPolicy.guard: [W] The all-duration 32-bit count guard (photometerMaximumCallbacks) uses 5 x the exact 100 s count (5005 at 100 ms) under the exact rule; no bundled target's decision changes (closest ratio 0.9899 on the 0.4 m).

uncertainty: [I] The precision/rounding control stays 0x1332 at run time.
[W] The browser still schedules one admitted callback per timer tick with no catch-up; VCL message-queue coalescing of WM_TIMER is not modelled (integration-provenance.json browserPolicy).
[W] The web series time is the cumulative callbacks x Timer of the whole series; VIREO shows the current period's elapsed.
rights: Derived from already-approved resources and the static reading of CLEA_VEO.exe; no original bytes beyond the 46 recorded constant bytes.

seriesReference.method: The earlier independent generator (Poisson by AST from analytic-vectors.py, Decimal90 finite quadrature, Decimal70 reduction) with the period length taken from the witness table; each pair computed nominal and exact. The nominal U 100 s x 5 pair reproduces integration-vectors.json pair 12.
seriesReference.effect: At 100 s the object counts rise by about 0.1 % (ratio 1.00098 to 1.00101) and so does the base-count sum, which the reduction divides by the same 100 s; the magnitudes move by 3e-6 to 2.2e-5 mag in the four reference pairs (seeded draws, not a bias).
